s: According to the Union Agriculture Department (18 October 2026), which State recorded the biggest fall in paddy area in the 2026-27 Kharif season?
x: Telangana's paddy area fell by 4.26 lakh ha, the biggest fall, followed by Karnataka (4.23 lakh ha).

s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Paddy area in the 2026-27 Kharif season fell by 15.56 lakh hectares.
2. Area under pulses in the 2026-27 Kharif season fell by 2.57 lakh hectares.
3. Odisha recorded a marginal rise in paddy area.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Statements 1 and 3 are correct. Area under pulses rose, not fell, by 2.57 lakh hectares.

s: SEBI's investor awareness programme "Samajh Se Investing Simple" was launched in October 2026 under which project?
x: "Samajh Se Investing Simple" was launched under SEBI's Project Jagruk on 5 October 2026.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)?
o: It became a statutory body under the SEBI Act, 1992.
Its headquarters is in New Delhi.
Its Chairman is Tuhin Kanta Pandey.
x: SEBI's headquarters is in Mumbai, not New Delhi.

s: The Finance Ministry's Monthly Economic Review for September 2026 estimated India's real GDP growth in Q2 (July-September) 2026-27 at:
x: The Monthly Economic Review estimated real GDP growth at 7.3% in Q2 2026-27.

s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The Q2 2026-27 real GDP estimate in the Finance Ministry's Monthly Economic Review came from a nowcasting model first presented in the Economic Survey 2026.
2. According to the Review, Q2 2026-27 growth was driven mainly by exports.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Only statement 1 is correct. Growth was driven by domestic demand and investment, not exports.

s: How many States are members of the new GST Standing Committee formed in October 2026?
x: The new GST Standing Committee has 12 States: 5 large, 4 medium and 3 small.

s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The new GST Standing Committee has 5 large, 4 medium and 3 small States.
2. Seven seats of the GST Standing Committee rotate every two years.
3. Kerala is a permanent member of the GST Standing Committee.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. The permanent members are Karnataka, Maharashtra, Uttar Pradesh, Gujarat and Tamil Nadu; Kerala is not one of them.

s: In October 2026, Fitch BMI raised India's FY2026-27 growth forecast to:
x: Fitch BMI raised India's FY2026-27 growth forecast from 6.8% to 7.5%.

s:
Consider the following statements:
1. BMI (Business Monitor International) is a division of Fitch Solutions.
2. Fitch BMI named crude oil prices and El Nino as risks to India's growth.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Both statements are correct. Fitch BMI also cut India's FY2027-28 forecast from 6.5% to 6.3%.

s: India's largest phenol-acetone facility was inaugurated in October 2026 at:
x: The ₹6,000 crore phenol-acetone facility is at Haldia, Purba Medinipur district, West Bengal.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about India's largest phenol-acetone facility inaugurated at Haldia in October 2026?
o: It was built by Adperma Private Limited, a subsidiary of Haldia Petrochemicals Limited.
It involves an investment of ₹6,000 crore.
It is the first phenol plant on India's western coast.
It is located in Purba Medinipur district.
x: It is the first phenol plant on India's eastern coast, not the western coast.

s: Phenol and acetone are made together by which industrial process?
x: Phenol (C6H5OH) and acetone (C3H6O) are produced together by the cumene process.

s: The RBI Greenfield Data Centre inaugurated by the Prime Minister on 25 October 2026 is located at:
x: It is at Info Valley-II, Jatni, Khordha district near Bhubaneswar, Odisha.

s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The RBI Greenfield Data Centre at Jatni is a backup and disaster-recovery centre for RBI's main data centre in Chennai.
2. Its foundation was laid on 22 March 2023 by then RBI Governor Shaktikanta Das.
3. It cost ₹169 crore and is spread over 18.55 acres.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Statements 2 and 3 are correct. RBI's main data centre is in Navi Mumbai, not Chennai.

s: With reference to the inauguration of the RBI Greenfield Data Centre in Odisha on 25 October 2026, which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Governor of Odisha – Mohan Charan Majhi
Chief Minister of Odisha – Braj Mohan Ram
x: Sanjay Malhotra is the RBI Governor. Braj Mohan Ram is the Odisha Governor, Mohan Charan Majhi the CM, and the foundation was laid in 2023.

s: In October 2026, India set a target of how much fish production in five years?
x: India targets 30 million tonnes of fish production in five years, up from 19.7 million tonnes.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about India's fisheries sector?
o: The National Fisheries Development Board (NFDB) is headquartered in Hyderabad.
World Fisheries Day is observed on 21 November.
The marine exports target is ₹1.25 lakh crore.
The Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) was launched in 2018.
x: PMMSY was launched in 2020, not 2018.

s: The National Strategic Trade Command Centre (NSTCC) was inaugurated in October 2026 at:
x: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal inaugurated the NSTCC at Vanijya Bhawan, New Delhi.

s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The National Strategic Trade Command Centre (NSTCC) was developed by the Department of Commerce with DGFT.
2. In SCOMET, the letter 'S' stands for 'Software'.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Only statement 1 is correct. SCOMET stands for Special Chemicals, Organisms, Materials, Equipment and Technologies.

s: In October 2026, the State Bank of India launched its "CyRIS" Cyber Security Centre of Excellence in which city?
x: SBI launched the CyRIS Cyber Security Centre of Excellence in Mumbai on 30 October 2026.

s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The State Bank of India was established on 1 July 1955 under the SBI Act, 1955.
2. SBI was formed after nationalising the Imperial Bank of India.
3. C.S. Setty is the Chairman of SBI.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: All three statements are correct.

s: India's gross GST collection for October 2026 was:
x: Gross GST collection in October 2026 was ₹2.31 lakh crore, up 22.9% year on year.

s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Gross GST collection in October 2026 grew 22.9% year on year.
2. GST from imports in October 2026 grew 42.2%.
3. Net GST collection in October 2026 grew 15.8%.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Net GST grew 25.6%; 15.8% was the growth in domestic GST.

s: Which of the following pairs of October 2026 facilities and their locations is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: RBI Greenfield Data Centre – Navi Mumbai
SBI CyRIS Cyber Security Centre of Excellence – Mumbai
National Strategic Trade Command Centre – Vanijya Bhawan, New Delhi
x: The RBI Greenfield Data Centre is at Jatni, Khordha district, Odisha; it backs up RBI's main data centre in Navi Mumbai.
